card.name: Words just before a time expression
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces where the next word is likely a time word such as time, date, period or night. Examples are the start of a year, 'than the' before 'present', 'each' before 'night', and 'over' before 'prolonged periods'.

modes.label: Partway through a year or number
modes.description: The first digit or a piece of a date or number, where more digits or a time unit follow.
modes.example: All children in school by <<2>>003; all children to complete

modes.description: A small word that leads into a time phrase such as present, night, periods or New Year.
modes.example: use<< over>> prolonged periods, use under occlusion,
